title: ObsCore
description: Observation Data Model Core Components (ObsCoreDM) v1.1 as approved by IVOA

calib_level.description: Calibration level of the observation: in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}

target_class.description: Class of the Target object as in SSA

obs_id.description: Internal ID given by the ObsTAP service

obs_title.description: Brief description of dataset in free format

obs_creation_date.description: Date when the dataset was created

obs_creator_name.description: Name of the creator of the data

obs_creator_did.description: IVOA dataset identifier given by the creator

obs_publisher_did.description: ID for the Dataset given by the publisher.

access_estsize.description: Estimated size of dataset: in kilobytes

s_ra.description: Central Spatial Position in ICRS Right ascension [deg]

s_dec.description: Central Spatial Position in ICRS Declination [deg]

s_fov.description: Estimated size of the covered region as the diameter of a containing circle [deg]

s_region.description: Sky region covered by the data product (expressed in ICRS frame)

s_resolution.description: Spatial resolution of data as FWHM of PSF [arcsec]

s_xel1.description: Number of elements along the first coordinate of the spatial axis

s_xel2.description: Number of elements along the second coordinate of the spatial axis

s_ucd.description: UCD for the nature of the spatial axis (pos or u,v data)

s_resolution_min.description: Resolution min value on spatial axis (FHWM of PSF) [arcsec]

s_resolution_max.description: Resolution max value on spatial axis [arcsec]

s_calib_status.description: Type of calibration along the spatial axis

s_stat_error.description: Astrometric precision along the spatial axis [arcsec]

s_pixel_scale.description: Sampling period in world coordinate units along the spatial axis [arcsec]

t_xel.description: Number of elements along the time axis

t_refpos.description: Time Axis Reference Position as defined in STC REC, Section 4.4.1.1.1

em_xel.description: Number of elements along the spectral axis

em_res_power.description: Value of the resolving power along the spectral axis. (R)

em_res_power_min.description: Resolving power min value on spectral axis

em_res_power_max.description: Resolving power max value on spectral axis

em_resolution.description: Value of Resolution along the spectral axis [m]

o_unit.description: Units used for the observable values

o_calib_status.description: Type of calibration for the observable coordinate

o_stat_error.description: Statistical error on the Observable axis

pol_xel.description: Number of elements along the polarization axis

pol_states.description: List of polarization states present in the data file

instrument_name.description: The name of the instrument used for the observation

proposal_id.description: Identifier of proposal to which observation belongs
